list.title: Parents
list.description: Everyone linked to your school, newest first.
list.emptyTitle: No parents are linked to your school yet
list.emptyBody: Register a parent to see their address and students here.
list.linkEnded: {{name}} is no longer linked to your school. Their account and links to other schools were not changed.

school.missingTitle: No school is assigned to this session
school.missingBody: This account is signed in as School Manager, but the system didn't report a school for it, so parents can't be shown. Nothing was loaded. Please contact your administrator.

register.title: Add a parent
register.description: Register a parent and link them to your school.
register.name: Full name
register.nameHint: Three names, for example: first, father and grandfather.
register.phoneHint: Used to find an existing account or create a new one.
register.addressHint: Write it as Governorate / Center or city / Village. The governorate must match an active governorate exactly.
register.successNewAccount: A new login account was created for this phone number. The parent must change the initial password the first time they sign in.
register.successExistingAccount: This phone number already had an account. The parent is now linked to your school and the account was left as it was.

details.loadError: This parent could not be loaded
details.endLinkHint: Removes only this school's link. The parent and their account stay.
details.notLinked: This parent is no longer linked to your school, so school actions are unavailable.

students.title: Students
students.emptyBody: Students registered under this parent will appear here.
students.emptyFilteredBody: Try another status to see the rest.

editAddress.title: Edit address
editAddress.description: Correct the address on record. Name and phone can't be changed here, and the previous address is kept in the history.
editAddress.unchanged: Change the address to enable saving.

endLink.intro: This ends the relationship between the parent and your school only.
endLink.keep1: The parent record and their login account
endLink.blocked: It can't be ended while the parent still has students in this school.

errors.INVALID_PARENT_NAME: Enter the parent's full name as exactly three names.
errors.INVALID_PARENT_ADDRESS: The address isn't in the expected format. Write it as Governorate / Center or city / Village.
errors.PARENT_ADDRESS_GOVERNORATE_NOT_FOUND: No governorate with this name was found. Write the governorate exactly as it is registered.
errors.PARENT_ADDRESS_GOVERNORATE_INACTIVE: This governorate is not active, so it can't be used in an address.
errors.PARENT_ADDRESS_COUNTRY_MISMATCH: This governorate belongs to a different country than your organization.
errors.INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER: The phone number isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.PARENT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: This phone number belongs to an existing account whose details don't match this parent. Check the name and phone number.
errors.PARENT_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The account for this phone number is inactive, so the parent can't be added.
errors.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_CONFLICT: This parent is already registered under a different organization.
errors.PARENT_ALREADY_LINKED_TO_SCHOOL: This parent is already linked to your school.
errors.PARENT_UPDATE_EMPTY: There is nothing to update. Change the address first.
errors.PARENT_HAS_STUDENTS_IN_SCHOOL: The link can't be ended because this parent still has students in your school.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the entered data isn't valid. Check the highlighted fields.
